lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno said I'm under the weather,
A rain cloud followed, wetter and wetter!
Kiki giggled, that's not the deal,
It's how you feel, not rain that's real!
[chorus]
Under the weather, under the weather,
Feeling sick, not cloudy forever!
Under the weather, under the weather,
Rest and tea will make you better!
[verse]
It means you're feeling a little ill,
A sniffle, a cough, a tiny chill,
Stay in bed and take it slow,
Soon you'll feel the sunshine glow!
[chorus]
Under the weather, under the weather,
Feeling sick, not cloudy forever!
Under the weather, under the weather,
Warm soup and rest will make you better!
[outro]
So if you're sniffly, tired and grey,
You're under the weather, rest today!
